entities.name: Flitwing
entities.description: A faerie working as an Azorius Senate detective.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that employs detectives such as Flitwing.

entities.name: Jabs
entities.description: A human puppeteer in the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild to which Jabs belongs.

entities.name: Muckslinger Gang
entities.description: A goblin, viashino, and beast trio living in Ravnica's sewers who petitioned to become the plane's eleventh guild.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The living Guildpact of Ravnica, who rejected the Muckslinger Gang's petition.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of guilds where these characters live.

entities.name: Nephilim Epochal
entities.description: An elder nephilim whose awakening awoke the five other Nephilim.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Ancient beings of Ravnica, five of which were awoken by Nephilim Epochal.

events.summary: The Muckslinger Gang petitioned Niv-Mizzet to become Ravnica's eleventh guild and were soundly rejected.
events.quote: They petitioned Niv-Mizzet , the living Guildpact , to become the plane's eleventh guild, and were soundly rejected.

events.summary: Nephilim Epochal awoke and in doing so awoke the five other Nephilim.
events.quote: When it awoke, it awoke the five other Nephilim.
